title: NASA-UAP-D032, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 3, 1996
what_is_it: A photograph (NASA astronaut still image) of an unidentified object taken from orbit during a Space Shuttle mission.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extracted from the document (likely a scanned or image-only file); all facts derive from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the document body.

The 'unidentified object' characterisation and its apparent trajectory are descriptive claims from the catalogue, not confirmed physical analysis; orbital debris, ice particles, or nearby space hardware are common conventional explanations for such shuttle-camera objects.
This is a single still frame from a three-image set; interpretation depends on the full sequence and camera/orbital context not present here.
Apparent position and motion in a photograph can be affected by camera focus, lighting, and parallax, and do not by themselves establish distance, size, or origin.

verifiable_claims.claim: Astronauts captured a series of three images of an unidentified object in low-Earth orbit.
